# OpenMUN

> OpenMUN is a free, open-source, serverless web application for Model United Nations (MUN) simulations and academic debate committees.

OpenMUN enables Chairs, Secretariats, and Delegates to moderate committee debates in real time without paper or backend servers. It runs entirely in the browser using client-side state, WebRTC/WebSocket synchronization, and optional Google Drive cloud backup.

## Key Capabilities
- General Speakers List (GSL): Order management, speaker countdowns, yields, and real-time speaking queues.
- Dynamic Debate Timers: Moderated and unmoderated caucus timers with visual and audio chime alerts.
- Roll Call & Quorum: Attendance matrix tracking Present and Present & Voting delegations with automatic simple and 2/3 majority calculations.
- Motions & Amendments: Formal caucus motions, amendment proposal mailboxes, and substantive/procedural voting boards with veto tracking.
- Multi-Role Live Sync: Peer-to-peer and WebSocket synchronization between Chair consoles, Secretariat oversight, and Delegate live projection screens.
- Privacy & Offline-First: 0 tracking cookies, 100% local storage persistence, AGPLv3 licensed.
